sources.title: Qwen3-32B model card
sources.evidence: Reopened the checkpoint card and raw README on October 27: the developer still reports 32.8B total and 31.2B non-embedding parameters. The card documents text generation, thinking/non-thinking modes, tool calling and local deployment. Native context is 32,768; YaRN is validated to 131,072 tokens.

sources.title: Qwen3: Think Deeper, Act Faster
sources.evidence: April 29, 2025 launch announcement explicitly includes Qwen3-32B among six dense, open-weight models under Apache 2.0; situates Qwen3 within the Qwen family.

sources.title: Qwen3-32B configuration
sources.evidence: Qwen3ForCausalLM configuration has 64 layers, 64 query heads and eight KV heads, model_type qwen3, no expert routing, max_position_embeddings 40960 and rope_scaling null.

sources.title: Official Qwen3 repository
sources.evidence: Identifies the developer as Qwen team, Alibaba Cloud; release news explicitly dates the Qwen3 series release 2025.04.29.

sources.title: Qwen3-32B license
sources.evidence: The exact checkpoint repository contains the Apache License, Version 2.0.

sources.title: Qwen3-32B commit history
sources.evidence: Shows the checkpoint upload on April 28, 2025, before the April 29 announcement. Upload history does not establish when the repository became public.

sources.title: Qwen3 Technical Report, Tables 4, 13 and 14
sources.evidence: Freshly checked Tables 13 and 14: the post-trained Qwen3-32B is explicitly listed as dense with 32B activated parameters in both thinking and non-thinking modes. Table 4 reports the same nominal count for its base model. These tables also use nominal 32B totals; the checkpoint card supplies the more precise 32.8B total. The arXiv record still lists only the May 14, 2025 v1 report.

sources.title: Qwen3 developer documentation: naming convention
sources.evidence: The naming section says dense model labels use total saved parameters, while MoE labels separately identify activated parameters per token. Thus the 32B model name alone is not an active-count disclosure; the technical report provides the separate explicit figure.

name.note: Display normalization of the official Qwen3-32B name.

developer.note: Developed by the Qwen team at Alibaba Cloud.

family.note: Qwen3 is explicitly part of the Qwen family.

release_date.note: Explicit developer release date. April 28 is an upload date; the baseline's public-release date is not independently established.

open_weights.note: Public checkpoint and explicit open-weight release announcement.

license.note: Checkpoint license and release announcement agree.

parameters_b.note: Retain the developer-published 32.8B total from the freshly checked model card, preserving its precision rather than replacing it with the technical report's nominal 32B total.

active_parameters_b.note: Developer-published nominal 32B activated parameters in Tables 13 and 14 for thinking and non-thinking Qwen3-32B. Preserve that published precision; do not infer 32.8B active from the total or substitute the distinct 31.2B non-embedding count.

architecture.note: Explicitly dense; causal Transformer with grouped-query attention.

context_window.note: Maximum with YaRN, not native context. The shipped configuration sets 40,960 positions without scaling.

modalities.note: Text causal language model and text-chat examples; no multimodal components.

description.value: Dense open Qwen model for self-hosted chat, reasoning, and coding
description.note: Supported by the deployment examples and documented capabilities.

patch.notes: Developer reports 32.8B total and nominal 32B activated parameters (technical report, Tables 13–14); 31.2B is the separate non-embedding count. Context is 32,768 natively and 131,072 with YaRN; shipped config allows 40,960 positions without scaling. Release uses the explicit April 29 announcement; April 28 checkpoint uploads do not establish public availability.

summary: Fresh parameter re-audit retains the model card's 32.8B total and resolves active parameters to the developer's nominal 32B in technical report Tables 13–14. The active figure is independently published, not inferred from dense architecture or the 31.2B non-embedding count. Existing release, license, architecture, context and capability assessments are unchanged.
